workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The approved Beat Plan has multiple beats, but the movement can be realized as one structured artifact unless a medium plan accepts cumulative expansion.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests dependent parts, a sequence or series, durable canon, or long-form drafting across sessions.

story_structure.name: Hero's Journey
story_structure.core_movement: An archivist begins inside institutional forgetfulness, crosses a sonic threshold into erased community memory, undergoes an ordeal that makes archiving morally charged, gains a burdened recording, and returns it to a community that must decide how to hear it.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The rehearsal compresses Hero Journey into five Beat Plan beats: ordinary world, call/threshold, ordeal, boon, and return residue. Helper/trials are implied through the recorded voices and erased route rather than separate beats.
story_structure.turn_logic: The audience first expects a private archival discovery, then realizes the journey's force is whether recovered memory can re-enter public life without becoming comfort or accusation alone.
story_structure.compression_rule: Keep ordinary world, threshold, ordeal, boon, and return residue. Treat helper, trials, and road details as implied pressures unless expansion requires separate beats.
story_structure.expansion_rule: If expanded, split the erased route into trials where each vanished place tests a different assumption about preservation, complicity, and who the returned memory is for.
failure_modes: the archivist becomes a heroic savior who owns the recovered memory
the boon becomes private victory without return pressure
the erased neighborhood becomes nostalgic atmosphere instead of an obligation
the return resolves community conflict too neatly

beats.one_move_summary: The archivist receives unlabeled tapes inside a community institution that has learned to treat erased memory as obsolete storage.
beats.before_state: The tapes are presumed blank, obsolete, or merely administrative.
beats.after_state: The archivist senses that ordinary cataloging may not be enough.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: Unlabeled tapes from a closed center should be sorted, discarded, or cataloged.
expectation_turn.actual_result: Their silence feels like a pressure before any content is heard.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The ordinary world is exposed as forgetfulness, not neutral order.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Professional calm carries shame before the journey begins.

beats.intended_feeling: the discomfort of realizing a clean archive may hide abandonment
beats.emotional_payload: The ordinary world is safe because it has stopped listening.

tension_profile.name: Order / Obligation
tension_profile.emotional_function: turns cataloging from routine into responsibility

tension_profile.name: Presence / Absence
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the unlabeled tapes feel full of withheld presence

source_evidence: The reference begins with unlabeled cassette tapes from a closed neighborhood center.

pivot_options.label: play-tape
pivot_options.next_move: The archivist listens after midnight and hears erased streets.
pivot_options.rationale: This creates the call and sonic threshold without changing medium.

traceability_notes.note: The opening grounds the ordinary world in the inherited tapes and closed center.

beats.one_move_summary: At midnight the tape speaks vanished street names, pulling the archivist out of cataloging and into a sonic route.
beats.before_state: The archivist can still treat the tapes as objects to preserve.
beats.after_state: She is summoned to follow memory as a field with different rules.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: Playing the tape should reveal information that can be labeled.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The voices name streets that no longer exist and demand movement.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The call makes archive work spatial, bodily, and irreversible.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Wonder is edged by dread because the voices are children.

beats.intended_feeling: the uncanny pull of being called by a place that official maps erased
beats.emotional_payload: The threshold is crossed through listening before walking.

tension_profile.name: Known / Unknown
tension_profile.emotional_function: moves the archivist from labeled objects into mystery

tension_profile.name: Safety / Exposure
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the sonic route feel emotionally irreversible

source_evidence: She hears children's voices naming streets that no longer exist.

pivot_options.label: walk-route
pivot_options.next_move: The archivist follows the erased route alone.
pivot_options.rationale: The threshold must become ordeal rather than information gathering.

traceability_notes.note: The call begins the return obligation by making memory impossible to keep private.

beats.one_move_summary: Walking the erased route, the archivist realizes preservation is not neutral because every recovered place names a communal failure.
beats.before_state: She imagines recovery as an act of care that can remain gentle.
beats.after_state: She understands that returning memory will also accuse the living.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The journey should reward listening with restorative discovery.
expectation_turn.actual_result: Each vanished place makes the archivist feel implicated in what was allowed to disappear.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The ordeal strips away the fantasy of neutral archiving.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Reverence turns into responsibility with no clean innocence.

beats.intended_feeling: the exposed grief of learning that care arrives late
beats.emotional_payload: The old self who only preserves records cannot carry the truth alone.

tension_profile.name: Care / Complicity
tension_profile.emotional_function: forces the symbolic death of neutral preservation

tension_profile.name: Memory / Accusation
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the recovered route from becoming nostalgia

source_evidence: She walks the erased route alone, finding each vanished place through sound.

pivot_options.label: carry-boon
pivot_options.next_move: She copies one tape knowing it will burden the room.
pivot_options.rationale: The boon must be gained as responsibility, not possession.

traceability_notes.note: The ordeal preserves the constraint that the erased neighborhood is an obligation, not atmosphere.

beats.one_move_summary: At dawn she returns with a copied tape, carrying not proof of ownership but a burden that must be heard by others.
beats.before_state: The recovered voices could become her private discovery.
beats.after_state: The copy becomes a public obligation she cannot control.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: The boon should empower the archivist as the one who recovered the lost material.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The copied tape removes her authority by requiring communal hearing.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The gain is a burden that must be returned, not a trophy.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: Achievement is shadowed by dread of what the room will hear.

beats.intended_feeling: the solemn weight of bringing back something that will not belong to you
beats.emotional_payload: The boon matters because it must leave the hero's hands.

tension_profile.name: Possession / Stewardship
tension_profile.emotional_function: blocks a savior frame by making the boon communal

tension_profile.name: Power / Burden
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps transformation from becoming private victory

source_evidence: At dawn she returns with one copied tape.

pivot_options.label: return-test
pivot_options.next_move: Play the tape at the reopening meeting and let the room divide.
pivot_options.rationale: The return must test whether the boon can enter ordinary life.

traceability_notes.note: The boon is adapted as public obligation rather than private reward.

beats.one_move_summary: At the reopening meeting, the tape makes some listeners feel restored and others accused, proving return is a communal test.
beats.before_state: The community can reopen the center without confronting what vanished.
beats.after_state: The returned recording divides the room and changes what reopening means.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: Playing the recovered tape should create shared healing.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The room splits between restoration and accusation.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The return refuses simple repair and tests the community's ability to receive memory.

beats.intended_feeling: the hard dignity of a return that asks more than comfort
beats.emotional_payload: The gift changes the ordinary world by making forgetting impossible.

tension_profile.name: Restoration / Indictment
tension_profile.emotional_function: keeps the return honest and unresolved

tension_profile.name: Private / Communal
tension_profile.emotional_function: turns the journey's gain into shared responsibility

source_evidence: Playing it at the reopening meeting makes the room divide.

traceability_notes.note: The ending preserves the artist meaning that memory matters only when returned to communal responsibility.

tension_points.summary: The recovered memory restores belonging and accuses the community at the same time.
tension_points.emotional_payload: The gift is real because it makes forgetting impossible.
source_evidence: The room divides when the copied tape is played.

traceability_notes.note: The tension point protects memory as return obligation rather than private discovery.

key_emotional_movements.emotional_shift: clean cataloging becomes evidence of abandonment

traceability_notes.note: The ordinary world adapts the inherited tapes and closed center.

key_emotional_movements.emotional_shift: listening becomes crossing into erased memory

traceability_notes.note: The threshold is adapted as sonic and emotionally irreversible.
The ordeal strips away neutral archiving and keeps the journey from becoming self-improvement.
The boon is preserved as a returned obligation rather than a reward.
The return tests the community rather than celebrating the archivist.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: Move from institutional forgetfulness through sonic threshold and ordeal into a returned memory that restores and indicts at the same time.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: A lower adjacent shift can be waived only if the artist explicitly wants the journey to feel ritualistically steady and the return still creates communal pressure.

adjacent_beat_shifts.shift_summary: The tapes shift from storage objects into a sonic call that makes the archivist cross into erased memory.
The call stops being uncanny wonder and becomes accountability for what the community erased.
The ordeal yields a copied tape, but the gain shifts from discovery to stewardship.
The boon leaves the archivist's hands and becomes a divisive public test.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block if the archivist becomes a heroic owner of recovered memory, if the boon is private victory, or if the return avoids communal pressure.

arc_summary.beginning: The archivist inherits tapes inside an institution that has normalized forgetting.
arc_summary.turn: The sonic threshold and erased route reveal that preservation is not neutral.
arc_summary.ending_or_residue: The returned tape divides the community, making memory both restoration and indictment.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: An arc is necessary because the structure needs ordinary world, threshold, ordeal, boon, and return pressure to test Hero Journey without importing a savior frame.

traceability_summary.note: The Beat Plan adapts the invented reference's tapes, sonic threshold, erased route, copied tape, and divided return.
The adapted Hero Journey preserves memory as return obligation rather than private discovery.
Hero Journey guides ordinary world, threshold, ordeal, boon, and return pressure without choosing medium, output shape, asset count, or Cultural Format Structure.
